name: pi-acp-workbench
description: Pi agent over ACP, with streaming Markdown, LaTeX math and editor context.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Pi can execute commands and edit files in the workspace.

commands.title: Pi Workbench: Open Current Harness Login Terminal

piAcp.codex.command.description: Codex ACP adapter executable (not the interactive codex CLI). Install @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp on the extension host.

piAcp.codex.args.description: Arguments for the Codex ACP adapter, passed without a shell.

piAcp.codex.env.description: Codex-only environment overrides; Pi profile overrides are not inherited. Prefer external credential storage.

piAcp.codex.loginCommand.description: Interactive Codex CLI used by Open Login Terminal (runs codex login). This is separate from codex-acp.

piAcp.claude.command.description: Claude Code ACP adapter executable (not the interactive claude CLI). Install @agentclientprotocol/claude-agent-acp on the extension host.

piAcp.claude.args.description: Arguments for the Claude ACP adapter, passed without a shell.

piAcp.claude.env.description: Claude-only environment overrides; Pi profile overrides are not inherited. Prefer external credential storage.

piAcp.showThoughts.description: Show thought chunks when the agent emits them.

piAcp.sharedHistory.description: Share Codex/Claude history on this server. Pi always uses session-service history. Changes require reloading the window.

piAcp.persistHistory.description: Show and save client history. For Pi this only hides history in this client: the independent session service always persists tasks. Use Delete History to remove server records.

piAcp.maxContextChars.description: Maximum characters in an attached editor selection or file.

piAcp.serviceSocket.description: Pi session service Unix socket. Empty uses ~/.pi/pi-acp-workbench/service/sessions.sock. Pi processes and model environment are configured in sessions.json; reload the window after changing this path.

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build:service:test && vitest run --changed --passWithNoTests
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm run build:service:test && vitest run
scripts.verify: npm run test:all && npm run test:browser
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.test:contract:telegram: cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --features pi-acp-telegram-daemon/contract-test --target-dir rust/target/contract && node scripts/telegram-contract.mjs
scripts.test:integration:rust: npm run build:service:test && cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --features pi-acp-telegram-daemon/contract-test --target-dir rust/target/contract && node scripts/rust-integration.mjs
